title: Simit Sesame Ring Bread

seo.title: Turkish Simit Recipe: Authentic Sesame Ring Bread
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make authentic Turkish Simit at home with our easy-to-follow recipe. Enjoy these delicious sesame ring breads, perfect for breakfast or a snack!

seo.imageAlt: Freshly baked authentic Turkish Simit sesame ring bread on a cooling rack, ready to be enjoyed.
seo.imageCaption: Golden-brown and generously coated in sesame seeds, homemade Simit is a delightful taste of Turkey.

description: Simit is a beloved Turkish sesame-crusted bread ring, a staple for breakfast and a popular street food. Its unique texture comes from a quick dip in molasses before being generously coated in sesame seeds and baked to a golden perfection. Enjoy this iconic taste of Turkey, perfect with cheese, olives, or simply on its own.

instructions.title: Activate the Yeast
instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the warm water, active dry yeast, and granulated sugar. Stir gently and let it sit for 5-10 minutes until the mixture becomes foamy, indicating the yeast is active.

instructions.title: Prepare the Dough
instructions.text: Add the flour, salt, and olive oil to the activated yeast mixture. Mix with a spoon until a shaggy dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 8-10 minutes until it is smooth, elastic, and no longer sticky. Add a little more flour if needed, but be careful not to make it too stiff.

instructions.title: First Proof
instructions.text: Lightly grease a clean bowl with olive oil. Place the dough in the bowl, turning it once to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a clean kitchen towel and let it rise in a warm place for 1 to 1.5 hours, or until it has doubled in size.

instructions.title: Shape the Simit Rings
instructions.text: Gently punch down the risen dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a long rope, about 18-20 inches (45-50 cm) long. Twist two ropes together, then connect the ends to form a ring. Repeat with the remaining dough pieces. Preheat your oven to 400F (200C).

instructions.title: Prepare Molasses Dip and Sesame Seeds
instructions.text: In a shallow dish, whisk together the grape molasses and 1/2 cup of water. In another shallow dish, spread out the sesame seeds. Take each shaped simit ring, dip it into the molasses mixture, ensuring both sides are coated, then transfer it to the sesame seed dish and generously coat it with seeds.

instructions.title: Bake the Simit
instructions.text: Place the coated simit rings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving some space between them. Bake in the preheated oven for 18-25 minutes, or until golden brown and crusty. Once baked, transfer the simit to a wire rack to cool slightly before serving.

tips: For the most authentic taste, use genuine Turkish grape molasses (pekmez). If unavailable, date molasses is a good alternative.
Ensure your sesame seeds are untoasted; they will toast beautifully in the oven, giving a richer flavor and aroma.
Simit is best enjoyed fresh and warm. If you have leftovers, lightly toast them in a dry pan or oven to regain crispness.
